style_prefix: Moody illustrated science-fiction workplace noir, ink-wash shadows, restrained teal cream amber and steel-blue palette, expressive humane faces, precise readable industrial objects, cinematic square composition, purely pictorial interface symbols.

prompts.prompt: Wide crescent-shaped corporate clinic inside a rotating transfer habitat: six cream recovery-room doors, carpeted waiting bay, bright white privacy arc across the floor, curved glass entry doors, teal light strips, staff alcove, gray service doorway, compact brown-skinned shaved-headed worker in pale gray uniform resetting a linen cart.

Small rectangular neural-care room: padded contact couch and segmented crown, precise leaf-fold blanket, mineral-water cup, scent-wafer slot, teal wall light; compact brown-skinned shaved-headed hospitality worker in pale gray wrap uniform wipes the couch, square bruise behind her left ear.

Narrow gray service corridor behind clinic rooms: exposed ducts and cable trays, waist-high event counter with four amber pulse marks, red interlock symbol and shrinking white ring; older stocky technician in orange-blue coveralls works beside a black filter case while a shaved-headed worker holds a thin route foil.

Clinic authority tableau divided by a bright white floor arc: cleaner with linen cart, polished pale clinician in cream tunic and tall braided coworker on the room side; dark-skinned silver-curled auditor in navy jacket waits on the public side holding a transparent seal tray.

Worker at linen cart chooses among four physical levers: blanket seam for a route foil, service doorway with technician and counter printer, braided coworker holding two work slates, or cream-clad clinic lead extending a hand for the receipt; six doors and white privacy arc remain visible.

Silver-curled auditor in navy jacket enters curved glass doors and stops beyond the white floor arc; cream-clad clinician meets her, shaved-headed cleaner waits by Room C, braided coworker carries extra towels, older technician watches from gray service doorway.

Transparent seal tray holds one neat green-marked disposition at the white privacy arc; polished cream-clad clinician gestures toward six closed treatment rooms, silver-curled auditor reads twice, cleaner with a square bruise watches beside a linen cart.

Choice frame at clinic privacy arc: cleaner stands between a seal tray with one green disposition and two open narrow slots, Room C, older technician waiting through the service doorway, and cream-clad clinic lead guarding a shrinking purge control.

Close service-doorway alarm beat: waist-high counter shows four amber pulse marks, one red interlock and a bright white ring contracting toward zero; older technician reads it, cleaner watches, clinic lead reaches for purge control, auditor holds seal tray beyond floor arc.

Four-affordance purge scene: technician credential near event counter, cleaner hand near metal cart rail, auditor ready to seal a limited hold, clinic lead guarding Room C control; shrinking white ring cuts through soft teal clinic lighting.

Diagonal wide view of final disclosure threshold: white floor arc divides cleaner and clinic lead from auditor with clear seal tray and open record slots; technician holds black filter case, braided coworker carries two slates, Room C event counter remains visible through the service doorway.

Raw-session aftermath at privacy arc: optical cable joins Room C service port to auditor's clear tray, cleaner stands alone with square bruise visible, clinic lead holds green disposition, amber machine marks interrupt the soothing teal clinic.

Auditor seals thin supervisor route foil and narrow four-pulse maintenance strip beside a contradictory green disposition; cleaner keeps hands outside the tray, technician stands with filter case, clinic lead faces the joined objects across the white arc.

Clinic waiting bay turns into a witness: cleaner speaks across white arc, braided coworker raises work slate, technician raises maintenance strip, pilgrims lower calming headsets, cream-clad clinic lead stands by spotless rooms, soft-gray security waits behind curved doors.

Quiet three-worker staff-alcove aftermath: brushed steel cabinets, towels, linen cart and gray service doorway; older technician opens a black filter case, braided coworker holds an active work slate, cleaner helps lift the case with visibly empty hands.

Isolated staff-alcove aftermath: shaved-headed cleaner folds a cream blanket alone beside an inactive slate rack and leaves one corner sharply wrong while the spotless teal clinic and white privacy arc wait beyond.
